high_level_description: The image shows an indoor scene that appears to be under construction or renovation. The setting is a room with a wooden swing hanging from the ceiling by chains. The swing has a traditional design with intricate carvings on the backrest, featuring circular patterns and what looks like peacock motifs. The floor is unfinished, with dirt and debris scattered around, indicating ongoing work. There are pieces of wood and other construction materials lying on the ground. The room has large windows with metal grills, allowing natural light to enter.
